conclusion.reason: The canonical input schemas differ at exactly /properties/config/description. The 8.1.0 registry already contains the exact 8.1.0 fingerprint and keeps ha_set_integration classified as persistent_write.

diff.after: Flow form data. With 'domain': input for the new integration's config flow. With 'entry_id' alone: input for the entry's options flow (updates its options). Multi-step flows consume keys per step; menu steps take 'next_step_id' — a string, or a list of successive selections for flows that present more than one menu (e.g. a menu revisited after each branch, ending in a finish option). The step's data_schema is returned on validation errors so field names can be corrected.

config.description: Flow form data. With 'domain': input for the new integration's config flow. With 'entry_id' alone: input for the entry's options flow (updates its options). Multi-step flows consume keys per step; menu steps take 'next_step_id'. The step's data_schema is returned on validation errors so field names can be corrected.

domain.description: Integration domain to add (e.g. 'workday', 'local_calendar') — starts and drives that domain's config flow. Pass the flow's form fields in 'config'.

enabled.description: True to enable, False to disable the entry. Requires entry_id; mutually exclusive with 'domain' and 'config'.

entry_id.description: Config entry ID of an existing integration (enable/disable and options-update modes). Omit when adding via 'domain'.
